info.title: myli API
info.description: REST API of a self-hosted myli instance. Errors use RFC 9457 problem details.

needed.description: True until the first admin exists.

title.description: Short summary of the problem type.

detail.description: Explanation of this occurrence, written for the client. Never contains internals.

requestId.description: Matches the `X-Request-Id` response header and the server log lines for this request.

in.description: Which part of the request the field is in.

pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to the field within that part, e.g. `#/tags/0`.

detail.description: What is wrong with the field.

ValidationProblem.description: A request that failed schema validation.

type.description: Identifies the problem type. `about:blank` means the status code says everything, and `title` is then the standard status text.

title.description: Short summary of the problem type.

detail.description: Explanation of this occurrence, written for the client. Never contains internals.

requestId.description: Matches the `X-Request-Id` response header and the server log lines for this request.

Password.description: 15 to 128 characters, with a lowercase letter, an uppercase letter, a number and a special character (anything but a letter or a number, a space included).

nextBefore.description: Pass as `before` to get the next page. `null` on the last page.

actor.description: Who did it. `null` when nobody was signed in, as for a failed sign-in.

target.description: What it was done to, if anything.

metadata.description: Details that depend on the action, such as the email a failed sign-in tried.

deactivated.description: Deactivated users can't sign in. Deactivating them ended their sessions.

totalMinutes.description: Set only when it differs from prep plus cook. See `recipeTotalMinutes`.

normalizedName.description: The name lowercase and singular, without accents or punctuation.

name.description: As its creator wrote it. Allergens are lowercase: "tree nuts".

totalMinutes.description: Only when it differs from prep plus cook: `null` means their sum.

steps.description: In order. Each body is markdown.

Nutrition.description: Per serving, entered by hand. `null` for each value nobody entered.

label.description: "For the dough". A lone group needs none.

qty.description: `null` when the line has no quantity.

qtyMax.description: The top of a range ("2–3 cloves"): more than `qty`. Otherwise `null`.

unit.description: A unit from the unit table, by any of its names, or one typed by hand.

scalable.description: False for lines like "salt to taste", which never scale.

totalMinutes.description: Only when it differs from prep plus cook: `null` means their sum.

steps.description: In order. Each body is markdown.

type.description: Any type but `allergen`: the allergens are a fixed list.

unitSystem.description: How recipes show quantities. `imperial` is the US customary measures.

totalHits.description: How many recipes match, across every page.

facets.description: How many recipes each filter value would give. A filter that takes any of its values (cuisine, meal, difficulty) is counted without its own choices, so its other values' counts say what adding them would give.

name.description: As recipes’ ingredient names are read, for the `ingredient` filter.

recipes.description: How many recipes the caller may see use it.

queuedAt.description: When the rebuild was asked for.

rebuild.description: The latest rebuild, or null if there has been none.

role.description: The role the invitee gets on accepting.

status.description: `pending`: the link works. `expired`: it no longer does; resend or revoke it.

link.description: The link to share with the invitee. Present when myli does not email it itself. It is shown only once: myli stores only a hash of the token in it.

email.description: The new account gets this email address.

get.description: Public. True until the first admin exists, so the web app knows to show setup.

default.description: Any other error, as RFC 9457 problem details.

post.description: Public, and only works while no user exists. The new admin then signs in with the same email and password.

409.description: Setup is already complete, or another setup is in progress.

default.description: Any other error, as RFC 9457 problem details.

get.description: Admins only. Newest first, a page at a time.

schema.description: Only events older than this ID: the `nextBefore` of the previous page.

parameters.description: Only events older than this ID: the `nextBefore` of the previous page.
parameters.name: before

schema.description: Only events of this kind.

parameters.description: Only events of this kind.
parameters.name: action

default.description: Any other error, as RFC 9457 problem details.

get.description: Admins only. Every user, deactivated ones included, oldest first.

default.description: Any other error, as RFC 9457 problem details.

put.description: Admins only. Applies from the user's next request. Admins can't change their own role, so an active admin always remains. Setting the role the user already has changes nothing.

200.description: The user, with their role now.

default.description: Any other error, as RFC 9457 problem details.

post.description: Admins only. Ends the user's sessions and refuses their sign-ins until they're reactivated. Their recipes stay as they are: private ones stay private. Admins can't deactivate themselves, so an active admin always remains. Send `Content-Type: application/json` even though there is no body.

default.description: Any other error, as RFC 9457 problem details.

post.description: Admins only. The user can sign in again. Send `Content-Type: application/json` even though there is no body.

default.description: Any other error, as RFC 9457 problem details.

post.description: Editors and admins. The caller owns the new recipe. Ingredient lines are stored as sent: parse them with `parseIngredient` from `@myli/shared` and let the user confirm. A tag that no longer exists fails validation like any other field.

default.description: Any other error, as RFC 9457 problem details.

get.description: Any signed-in user, for shared recipes and their own private ones. Someone else's private recipe answers 404, exactly as one that never existed or was deleted.

404.description: No recipe has this ID, or the caller may not see it.

default.description: Any other error, as RFC 9457 problem details.

put.description: Editors and admins, for shared recipes and their own private ones: editors can edit any shared recipe, whoever created it. Replaces all of the recipe's content, lines, steps and tags included; its owner and visibility stay. Until drafts arrive, the last save wins.

403.description: The caller may see the recipe but not edit it.

404.description: No recipe has this ID, or the caller may not see it.

default.description: Any other error, as RFC 9457 problem details.

delete.description: Its owner, or an admin for any recipe they can see. The recipe is hidden everywhere at once, and the deletion is recorded in the audit log. (Restoring it from the trash comes with Phase 2.) Send `Content-Type: application/json` even though there is no body.

403.description: The caller may see the recipe but not delete it.

404.description: No recipe has this ID, or the caller may not see it.

default.description: Any other error, as RFC 9457 problem details.

put.description: The recipe's owner only, admins included: a private recipe is seen by its owner alone, a shared one by everyone signed in. Setting the visibility it already has changes nothing.

200.description: The recipe, with its visibility now.

403.description: The caller may see the recipe but isn't its owner.

404.description: No recipe has this ID, or the caller may not see it.

default.description: Any other error, as RFC 9457 problem details.

get.description: Any signed-in user. Every tag, the allergens included, or every tag of one type.

schema.description: Only tags of this type.

parameters.description: Only tags of this type.
parameters.name: type

default.description: Any other error, as RFC 9457 problem details.

post.description: Editors and admins. If the type already has a tag with this name, ignoring case and spacing, that tag is returned instead of a new one, with status 200.

200.description: The tag that already had this name.

default.description: Any other error, as RFC 9457 problem details.

get.description: Any signed-in user's own display preferences, or the defaults until they choose.

default.description: Any other error, as RFC 9457 problem details.

put.description: Any signed-in user, viewers included: preferences change only what they see. Replaces all of them.

default.description: Any other error, as RFC 9457 problem details.

get.description: Any signed-in user. Finds only recipes the caller may see: shared ones, and their own private ones. Filters on different things all hold; within one, cuisines, meals and difficulties take any of their values, and diets and other tags all of them. Repeat a parameter for more than one value.

schema.description: What to look for. Typos are forgiven.

parameters.description: What to look for. Typos are forgiven.
parameters.name: q

schema.description: Where to look for it: everywhere, or only in ingredient names.

parameters.description: Where to look for it: everywhere, or only in ingredient names.
parameters.name: in

schema.description: Recipes with all of these ingredients, or a name that means the same (scallion, green onion). Names are read as recipes’ are: "Scallions" is "scallion".

parameters.description: Recipes with all of these ingredients, or a name that means the same (scallion, green onion). Names are read as recipes’ are: "Scallions" is "scallion".
parameters.name: ingredient

schema.description: Recipes of any of these cuisines.

parameters.description: Recipes of any of these cuisines.
parameters.name: cuisine

schema.description: Recipes for any of these meals.

parameters.description: Recipes for any of these meals.
parameters.name: mealType

schema.description: Recipes that fit all of these diets.

parameters.description: Recipes that fit all of these diets.
parameters.name: diet

schema.description: Recipes with all of these other tags.

parameters.description: Recipes with all of these other tags.
parameters.name: tag

schema.description: No recipes of these cuisines.

parameters.description: No recipes of these cuisines.
parameters.name: excludeCuisine

schema.description: No recipes for these meals.

parameters.description: No recipes for these meals.
parameters.name: excludeMealType

schema.description: No recipes that fit these diets.

parameters.description: No recipes that fit these diets.
parameters.name: excludeDiet

schema.description: No recipes with these other tags.

parameters.description: No recipes with these other tags.
parameters.name: excludeTag

schema.description: No recipes that contain any of these.

parameters.description: No recipes that contain any of these.
parameters.name: excludeAllergen

schema.description: Recipes of any of these difficulties.

parameters.description: Recipes of any of these difficulties.
parameters.name: difficulty

schema.description: Recipes that take at least this long in all.

parameters.description: Recipes that take at least this long in all.
parameters.name: minMinutes

schema.description: Recipes that take at most this long in all.

parameters.description: Recipes that take at most this long in all.
parameters.name: maxMinutes

schema.description: How to order them. Relevance with a query, newest without one.

parameters.description: How to order them. Relevance with a query, newest without one.
parameters.name: sort

200.description: One page of matching recipes, with the count of each filter value.

503.description: Search is unavailable. Everything else works.

default.description: Any other error, as RFC 9457 problem details.

get.description: Any signed-in user. Ingredient names that recipes the caller may see use, starting like the query, the most used first: for the `ingredient` filter of recipe search.

schema.description: The start of an ingredient name. Typos are forgiven. Empty for the most used.

parameters.description: The start of an ingredient name. Typos are forgiven. Empty for the most used.
parameters.name: q

503.description: Search is unavailable. Everything else works.

default.description: Any other error, as RFC 9457 problem details.

get.description: Admins only. Whether search works, and how the latest rebuild of its index went.

default.description: Any other error, as RFC 9457 problem details.

post.description: Admins only. Rebuilds the index from the database in the background, then swaps it in; search keeps working meanwhile. If a rebuild is already waiting or under way, that one stands. While search is unavailable, the rebuild waits for it.

202.description: The search index, with the rebuild asked for.

default.description: Any other error, as RFC 9457 problem details.

get.description: Admins only. Every invitation that is neither accepted nor revoked, newest first, including expired ones, which an admin resends or revokes.

default.description: Any other error, as RFC 9457 problem details.

post.description: Admins only. Creates an invitation with the role the invitee will get.

409.description: A user, or an open invitation, already has this email.

default.description: Any other error, as RFC 9457 problem details.

post.description: Admins only. Issues a new link that works for the full invitation lifetime again, and stops the old link working. Works on expired invitations too. Send `Content-Type: application/json` even though there is no body.

200.description: The invitation has a new link.

404.description: No open invitation has this ID.

409.description: A user with this email exists now.

default.description: Any other error, as RFC 9457 problem details.

post.description: Admins only. The link stops working, and the email can be invited again. Send `Content-Type: application/json` even though there is no body.

404.description: No open invitation has this ID.

default.description: Any other error, as RFC 9457 problem details.

post.description: Public. Returns what the invitation is for, if the link still works. The token is sent in the body, never the URL, so it stays out of logs.

404.description: The link is invalid, expired, revoked or already used.

default.description: Any other error, as RFC 9457 problem details.

post.description: Public. Creates the account, with the invited email and role. It does not sign in: the new user then signs in with the same email and password.

404.description: The link is invalid, expired, revoked or already used.

409.description: A user with this email already exists.

default.description: Any other error, as RFC 9457 problem details.
